title: Orders slows down after a deploy

review.note: Read every string; trimmed the cut last sentence of the diagnosis.

diagnosis.summary: Orders p95 rose from about 24 ms to about 2400 ms right after deploy d-107 (12:00:47Z). The commit "add inventory freshness check" makes reserveStock await 8 warehouse checks one after another, each sleeping 200 ms. That adds about 1600 ms per request, which matches the logged POST /orders latencies of about 1622 ms. No errors were recorded, only latency.

hunt.fixHint: Revert d-107, or run the warehouse freshness checks in parallel (Promise.all). Better still, drop the 200 ms per-warehouse wait or take it off the request path, and cache the results.
